guards.guard: the unit CHECKS an inheritance relation; it never assigns case — case facts stay two-vote gated
scripture and text are never 'corrected': a mismatch is a violation_candidate routed to review
attachment is SUPPLIED: the unit never decides which preceding constituent is the joined-to element, and a wrong head makes the whole check void
og-4: a connector's coordinating reading is per-occurrence; the documented non-coordinating uses of these same items are not adjudicated here

ENCODING LIMIT declared in the pack: a lane pins one case, so connector-to-lane assignment is an artifact of the borrowed slot shape and is never to be read as a claim that a connector joins only that case
the semantic choice between the connectors rests on a world-time or discourse judgment with no formal cue; this unit checks case only and emits no semantic verdict
method transfers, conclusions do not: one occurrence's resolved head never fixes the head of another occurrence
